statement.contact: Should you detect any suspicious promotional materials misappropriating the Company's name or the aforementioned footage, please contact us immediately via Email at info@lango.ai or Tel at +852 9354 1948. The Company reserves all legal rights to pursue action against any institution or individual that falsely uses our name or damages our corporate reputation.
statement.footer: Please rely only on information published on this website and our official channels.
statement.greeting: To all our valued clients, partners, and members of the public:
statement.intro: Lango Innovation Limited (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") has recently identified individuals falsely claiming to be interview teams from national media outlets or authorized agencies. These individuals have been conducting unauthorized interviews at commercial exhibitions, attempting to lure businesses to cross-border locations under the guise of commercial selections, and demanding exorbitant fees. To protect the public interest and safeguard our corporate reputation, the Company hereby issues the following solemn statement:
statement.section1.body: During our participation in "Learning & Teaching Expo 2026" in late June 2026, the Company was approached for a brief on-site interview by a photography and editorial team claiming to represent "China Central Television (CCTV)". Following a strict internal review, the Company has confirmed that this team was NOT officially authorized or affiliated with CCTV, and their subsequent commercial events bear no relation to CCTV. The Company immediately refused to participate and has terminated all communications with said party.
statement.section1.title: No Collaboration with the Mentioned Entities:
statement.section2.body: During the aforementioned process, certain interview clips, photographs of our person-in-charge, and brief self-introduction videos were captured by the party under the pretext of an audition. The Company hereby strictly declares: The Company has never authorized any fraudulent media or unverified media agencies to use any of the aforementioned materials. Any entity or individual utilizing these clips, photographs, or the Company's name for any commercial promotion, recruitment, business selection, or financial solicitation is committing infringement and fraud, which has absolutely no connection with the Company.
statement.section2.title: No Authorization for Using Captured Footage and Images:
statement.section3.body: In response to this suspected case of fraud involving the impersonation of a media organization, the Company has officially filed a report and record with the e-Report Centre of the Hong Kong Police Force (case legally recorded) to prevent the unauthorized footage from being maliciously used for illegal purposes.
statement.section3.title: Report Filed with Law Enforcement:
statement.section4.body: The Company adheres strictly to the principles of integrity and business ethics. We will never participate in any unauthorized evaluation or promotional campaigns requiring on-the-spot payments of "deposits" or "promotional fees". We urge our clients, industry peers, and the public to remain highly vigilant against such fraudulent schemes.
statement.section4.title: Notice of Public Vigilance:
statement.title: Clarification on Fraudulent Media Interviews and Anti-Scam Notice
